guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The recommendationservice exhibits a massive latency spike (z=+893.38 at p90) that directly correlates with its presence in all five worst-performing traces. This internal processing delay propagates upstream to the frontendservice, triggering the alert without generating any error or warning logs.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or horizontally scale the recommendationservice pods to clear potential thread starvation or garbage collection pauses causing the processing delay.
